config.scene_description: Two happy kids side by side at a laptop, coding together. Warm, focused, joyful collaboration; code glows on the laptop screen facing them.

iterations.prompt:
Render a single landscape 1940s Golden-Age American comic-book panel — bold hand-inked black contour lines of varied weight, large unbroken areas of flat solid color, dramatic four-color printing look. This is authentic hand-drawn/inked comic art: NOT a photo, NOT painterly, NOT modern digital illustration.

COMPOSITION (follow the attached PHOTO reference for the staging): two happy kids side by side at a laptop, coding together, seen at a warm close three-quarter angle. In the FOREGROUND a girl in a bright pink/magenta long-sleeve top leans in and points one finger at the glowing laptop screen. Beside her a boy in a plaid/checked shirt watches the screen intently, resting his chin thoughtfully on his hand. The laptop is turned so we glimpse code glowing on the screen. Keep the two kids as the richly-inked heroes with expressive, proud, focused faces; simplify the background (a warm classroom nook) into bold graphic shapes. Leave clear open space in the UPPER-LEFT above the kids' heads for a headline, and clear space in the LOWER-RIGHT for a logo.

COLOR — warm orange-and-blue complementary palette (about 70% warm / 30% cool): a golden-amber and marigold field, burnt-orange and sienna warm shadows modeling the forms, steel-blue and deep-navy as the cool accent on edges and the deepest shadows; ink black anchors all linework; cream for the caption/balloon fills; the girl's top a vivid magenta-pink accent. Colors printed-comic VIVID, never muddy. Shadows are flat black hard-edged shapes — no gradients, no airbrush, no soft shading, and absolutely NO Ben-Day / halftone dots.

TEXT — render EXACTLY these three elements and nothing else:
1. HEADLINE, upper-left, arching in a big dramatic curved comic-book display font (bold, outlined, with a subtle 3-D pop), reading: FUN FRIENDS IN A FUTURE
2. A cream comic SPEECH BALLOON near the girl's shoulder, hand-lettered, with its tail pointing to the girl, reading: "Coding is SO much FUN — and we're building real skills for our future!"
3. In the LOWER-RIGHT, a LARGE, clean League of Amazing Programmers wordmark badge, reproduced faithfully from the attached black-and-white LOGO reference (the curved double-outline banner with three stacked lines — "THE LEAGUE OF", big "AMAZING", "PROGRAMMERS" — and the small flanking lightning bolts), re-colored into this comic's orange-blue four-color treatment (cream/gold lettering, steel-blue banner, black keylines). No other posters, signs, slogans, labels, or lettering anywhere. Code appears only on the laptop screen. Optimistic, cheerful, aspirational mood.
